newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures end lower,correct Friday's gains.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures end lower,correct Friday's gains.

text.p: Oct 7 - U.S. debt futures ended lower, correcting Friday's gains in extremely light trade. One house sold blocks of 300 Dec bonds throughout the day. Dec T-bonds fell to 111-03/32, through support at 111-04/32, but closed above that support area. March Euros closed below support at 94.30. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
